doc.title: Script
doc.body: A model writes the characters and their lines from the video's title and what it is about.

content.body:
Write the script for a short voiced video.
Title: $title
What it is about: $brief

Give it two to four characters and eight to sixteen lines, each line one or two sentences a voice actor can say.
Answer one output per character, slots "role 1", "role 2" and so on: components role {"video": the video's input id, "about": how the character sounds, in a few plain words such as "old man, gravelly, warm"} and doc {"title": the character's name}.
Answer one output per line, slots "line 1", "line 2" and so on in script order: components line {"video": the video's input id, "role": "$role N" naming the slot of the character who says it, "n": its number from 1} and doc {"body": the words said, with no stage directions}.
Every output lists the video's input id in its inputs.

doc.title: Voice auditions
doc.body: Three candidate voices each say a character's first line, and the person who asked for the video is asked which voice to use.

builder.query: $r .role, built.current=true, role.video=$v, role.about=$about, doc.title=$name; $v .video, created.by=$asker; [$l .line.role=$r, built.current=true, line.n=$n, doc.body=$said]

doc.title: Voice lines
doc.body: Each line is said in its character's chosen voice, as soon as that voice is chosen.

builder.query: $l .line, built.current=true, line.video=$video, line.role=$role, line.n=$n, doc.body=$text; $role .role, built.current=true, doc.title=$who; $d .decision, built.current=true, cast.role=$role, decided.choice=$name; $a .audition.role=$role, built.current=true, audition.name=$name, audition.voice=$voice

doc.title: Assemble
doc.body: Once every line is voiced, the lines are put in script order as the video's cut.

builder.query: $v .video, doc.title=$title, lines_video>=1; [$x .voicing.video=$v, built.current=true, voicing.n=$n, voicing.audio=$audio, doc.title=$who, doc.body=$text]; ![$l .line.video=$v, built.current=true; ![$y .voicing.line=$l, built.current=true]]
